footnote_text: On October 9, 2026, the entity of Trent D'Ambrosio, Digital Asset Medium LLC, assigned by gift for no consideration an aggregate of 9,750,000 shares as follows: (i) 9,500,000 shares to 4 D Investments LLC, an entity beneficially owned by Lance D'Ambrosio, the brother of Trent D'Ambrosio, (ii) 100,000 shares to Dan Gay, the issuer's COO, and (iii) 150,000 shares to non-affiliates of the issuer. Digital Asset Medium LLC also assigned by gift for no consideration 9,500,000 shares into Trent D'Ambrosio's individual name. No shares were issued by the issuer to Trent D'Ambrosio, his entity, or any other affiliates in connection with the reported assignments. || The amount of securities reported as directly owned by Trent D'Ambrosio following the October 9, 2026 assignments includes the 9,500,000 shares assigned by Mr. D'Ambrosio's entity, Digital Asset Medium LLC, to Mr. D'Ambrosio, as well as 369,328 shares held in Mr. D'Ambrosio's individual name prior to the assignment, but does not include shares held in other names that are deemed to be beneficially owned by Mr. D'Ambrosio, including (i) 399,862 shares still held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's entity, Digital Asset Medium LLC, (ii) 317 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's IRA, (iii) 329 shares held as custodian for Mr. D'Ambrosio's son, (iv) 100,000 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's son, or (vi) 32,609 shares held in the name of Mr. D'Ambrosio's spouse.
